From Talking Head · Price: your stand must touch the target's tongue (an open mouth, a bite).

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: curse a creature whose tongue your stand touches: the lie bites, @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}). On a failure, for 1 minute: everything it says is a lie; its body lies too, so the first action it takes on each of its turns comes out wrong and is lost (a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save at the end of each of its turns ends this); it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1}; and its blows go where its lies say you are, a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. It's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn. On a critical failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute, and the attack penalty is –2.
  • 5: Surge: the curse (as 1st), and the tongue locks, biting down: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}). On a failure the creature can't speak or use actions with the linguistic trait (no spells with verbal parts) for 1 round; on a critical failure for 1 minute, and it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} for 1 minute as its own lies tangle its thoughts.
  • 9: The curse lasts 1 hour.
  • 13: You know the truth of what it says, and it hears its own lies: a creature that fails its save against the curse or the surge is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} on a critical failure). The curse and its surge can each target up to two creatures.
  • 17: The curse lasts 1 day.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
